name: Runaway and Homeless Youth (RHY) Daily Census
description:
This dataset provides a daily census of beds and vacancies in Runaway and Homeless Youth (RHY) programs, broken out by date and program type. Each row records, for a given day and program category, the number of beds available (beds_per_day), the number of vacancies (vacancies_per_day), and a vacancy rate (vacant_per_day, ranging from 0 to 1). Program types include Crisis Shelters, Crisis Shelters (HYA), Transitional Independent Living (TIL), and Transitional Independent Living (HYA). The data spans many distinct dates, with bed counts ranging from 10 to 495 per day and vacancy rates averaging about 18%.

The dataset could be used to track bed availability and utilization over time, compare capacity and vacancy patterns across program types, identify periods of high or low demand, and support planning or reporting on shelter and transitional living resources for homeless youth.
